An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''governor''' controlled the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. He received bribes from the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Gamgalon]], to turn a blind eye to the hunting of [[Morodin/Legends|Morodin]]&mdash;a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;on the planet.
